description.en: Tencent Meeting command-line tool (CLI) built on the Tencent Meeting Open Platform OAuth2: meeting management, recording management and attendee reports; distributed as a CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy skill.
description.zh: 腾讯会议命令行工具（CLI），基于腾讯会议开放平台 OAuth2 授权，支持会议管理、录制管理、参会报告等；以 CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy Skill 形态分发。
